description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionTimeoutException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate that a subscription has timed out due to inactivity. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingSearchException, providing methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and setting headers. The class includes a builder for fluent construction.

classes.name: SubscriptionTimeoutException
classes.description: Custom exception representing a subscription timeout error in the Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionTimeoutException with a message indicating that the subscription with the given ID timed out.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a SubscriptionTimeoutException from a JSON object and headers, extracting relevant information.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SubscriptionTimeoutException instance with updated Ditto headers.
